verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a managed streaming service with Player and Broadcast SDKs, so opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry opt-out, data-collection controls, or usage-tracking settings. EventBridge stream monitoring is an operational feature, not a privacy control, and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
